prose: On Kodak at 10~dB, NeST-Com achieves DreamSim/CLIP-I of 0.110/0.869, versus 0.173/0.808 for Latent JSCC and 0.317/0.741 for ARPC. Its PSNR is 21.01~dB, below SwinJSCC (23.57~dB) and BPG (23.33~dB), but 3.44~dB above ARPC. NeST-Com also attains the lowest DreamSim and highest CLIP-I means at 4 and 19~dB; Latent JSCC retains lower LPIPS at 4~dB. At 10~dB, the NeST--Latent PSNR and LPIPS paired CIs include zero.
internal_comparison: On Kodak at 10~dB, utilization rises from 78.11\% to 94.99\%, with a 0.674~dB PSNR gain and a 0.0164 DreamSim reduction. The PSNR paired CIs are positive at all three SNRs; the 19~dB DreamSim interval includes zero.
